writing_guidelines.main_body_strategy: Clear exposition with strong motivation. Emphasize novelty and theoretical understanding. ICLR values understanding over pure empirical results.
writing_guidelines.figure_strategy: Single-column layout allows wider figures. Use clear, informative plots.
writing_guidelines.table_strategy: Booktabs style. Bold best values. Include error bars or confidence intervals.
writing_guidelines.proof_strategy: Key theoretical insights in main body, full proofs in appendix.
writing_guidelines.related_work_placement: Typically after introduction or before conclusion.

common_pitfalls: Not using the official ICLR style file
Forgetting double-blind anonymization (no author names, no identifying URLs)
Missing ablation studies or analysis of why the method works
